_purpose: Sample dataset for local development, the frontend teammates, and the demo map. Committed so the API is useful before any Bright Data collector exists.
_dates: Dates are relative. `days_ago` is converted to an absolute UTC date when `py -3.12 -m app.seed` runs, so the exponential decay in app/domain/convergence.py keeps producing meaningful scores whenever the seeder is run. Absolute dates would silently rot into a flat, zero-score map.
_pipeline: These are RAW collector rows, not signals. The seeder pushes them through app/domain/normalizer.normalize_batch, so the technology domain, the signal type (facility / grant / event) and the coordinates are all inferred by the same code a live run uses. A record that fails normalization aborts the seed instead of being skipped quietly.
_urls: Hostnames match each collector's real target so evidence links look like a live run's. The individual pages are illustrative.
